# Support

## Where to get help
- Use **GitHub Discussions** for questions, troubleshooting help, and general feedback.
- Use **GitHub Issues** for confirmed bugs and actionable work items.

## Before opening a ticket
- Check the README and docs in this repository.
- Search existing issues/discussions.

## What to include
- What you were trying to do
- What happened (error message / screenshot)
- Platform (web/android/ios/windows) and Flutter version
- Relevant logs (remove secrets)
